title: Gambit Vanguard
game_overview: Command chess pieces across a tactical board, then dive into intense 1v1 first-person shootouts with piece-specific weapons and upgrade perks.
winning_condition: Capture or eliminate the enemy King in an arena duel while preserving your own royal army.
losing_condition: Your King falls in battle or your pieces are wiped out by enemy forces.

controls.action: Select chess piece and target square on board; fire weapon in FPS duel.
Move forward, backward, and strafe laterally during FPS combat arena.
Aim first-person camera and weapon crosshair.
Jump upward to evade incoming enemy fire and projectiles.

sections.title: Campaign Levels & Progressive Difficulty
sections.content: Level 1: The Grand Chamber (Standard skirmish against the Apprentice AI). Level 2: Crimson Bastion (Fortified opponent units with +20% HP and aggressive Knight/Bishop flanking). Level 3: Obsidian Citadel (Grandmaster AI with elite perks, faster projectile speeds, and ruthless King defense).
sections.summary: Multi-tier campaign progressing across themed arenas with escalating enemy ranks and tactics.

sections.title: Atmospheric Title Screen & Presentation
sections.content: Presents an indie showcase main menu with cinematic 3D board backdrop, pulsing neon title logo, campaign chapter selection, sound toggles, and weapon arsenal codex preview.
sections.summary: Polished indie game aesthetic with dynamic 3D background camera sweeps, audio ambience, and campaign level select.
